admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories and disputed places are in scope. Somaliland (XS) is a disputed place (a self-declared state with no UN recognition, claimed by Somalia); it has no ISO 3166-1 code, so XS is a user-assigned code for the world-map entry (reviewed addition in bootstrap/timezone-data/reviewed-additions.json). In OpenStreetMap the only relation for it is relation 3586169 (Q34754), boundary=administrative with admin_level 3 and NO ISO3166-1 tag, so the default admin-0 rule (admin_level=2 with the ISO code) finds none. Territory, game venue map only, no claims: no claims about real operations, borders or sovereignty; OSM mapped boundary, not legal-border authority. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies.
